note: D15: multi-seed with --shuffle (the only stochastic source). rx-only, K=4, lr=5e-4, max_epochs=8. Vanilla full-finetune ref 0.7775.

comparison.verdict: V1 beats V2 by 0.0159 AUC; V1 std is ~12x smaller. Effect size is enormous relative to seed noise -> the V1>V2 conclusion is NOT a single-seed artifact.

g4_note: Without --shuffle all seeds return bit-identical AUC; every earlier "multi-seed" plan in D7/DRIVERS was infeasible. See DRIVERS G-4.
